overview_description.description: Kay Property Management specializes in buying, overseeing, maintaining and selling real estate properties on behalf of HNI’s. Our services typically include buying, selling, rent collection, property maintenance, tenant screening, and ensuring legal compliance. We aim to maximize the property's value while minimizing the owner's involvement in day-to-day operations.
